purpose: Show that a state has continued since a defining event.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Since coming to this town, I have walked along the river every morning.
I have not seen him since graduation.
I have been interested in space since reading that book.
restrictions: The event sets the starting point of a continuing state or repeated activity.
mistake: For a one-off later event, use てから rather than て以来.

segments.role: Show that a state has continued since a defining event. Vて + 以来

examples.translation: Since coming to this town, I have walked along the river every morning.
